items.title: Corner Gas (COMPLETE COLLECTION) [Slight W.I.P]
items.description: This upload has a lot of the officially released content surrounding the show "Corner Gas'. The main things missing are the many promos and other shows / pilots created by Brent Butt (Which I'm actively working to find, download, and archive to provide the best archive for this amazing show!).
